topics.title: Anthropic eyes a $2 trillion IPO valuation for an October debut
topics.why: If it lands, it would be one of the largest tech IPOs ever and shows how fast enterprise AI spending is repricing the whole market knowledge workers operate in.

topics.title: Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.3 just found 1,000+ real security bugs in production software
topics.why: An open coding model doing bug-hunting at that scale signals AI moving from writing code to auditing it -- worth tracking for anyone in engineering or security.

topics.title: Anthropic's Dario Amodei pushes back on claims his AI-safety warnings are fueling the backlash
topics.why: The industry's fight over its own safety messaging is becoming as consequential as the technology itself, shaping the policy environment knowledge workers will operate under.
